thread:
Ravi (Marketing): Need a mini visual kit for the launch: 1 benchmark tile, 3 social crops, webinar hero slide, and an 8.5x11 one-pager. Key constraints: accessible contrast, clear latency vs cost sparkline, and short AB copy variants. Deadline Wed EOD.

June (Design): Can do. Will produce light/dark/high-contrast variants and include alt-text notes. Any specific copy to plug in?

Ravi (Marketing): Copy options: 
- A: "Lower latency. Fewer dollars. Predictable inference." 
- B: "Serve LLMs reliably, with clear economics." 
Use A by default. CTA: "Try Redwood Inference" (alt: "Ship with Redwood").

Marta (Creative Ops): File formats: SVG master + PNG@1x/2x + PDF one-pager. Social sizes: LinkedIn 1200x628, X 1600x900, IG 1080x1080, mobile 640x360. Exports prioritized EN only.

Tom (Legal): Avoid numeric claims without attached benchmark doc. If you include numbers, add a visible footnote: "Based on internal tests; results vary by model and config." I'll review the final PDF.

June (Design): Noted. I'll set up a single Figma file with components and export presets. Will add a small two-column callout on the webinar slide: "Dedicated vs Hosted" with simple icons from our token set.

figma-bot: Figma file created: https://www.figma.com/file/EXAMPLE/mini-benchkit components: /bench-tile /social /webinar-slide

Marta (Creative Ops): Timeline: June 2 business days for first pass, me 1 day for QA and exports. I'll include accessibility contrast screenshots and a delivery checklist.

Ravi (Marketing): Great. Ping here immediately if scope creep (animations, extra languages) appears. Thanks! :thumbsup:
